backgroundSkills.localised_description: Amidst the vast and desolate Eastern Steppes, the Great Herds are among its fiercest denizens. Beastmen frothing at the mouth with hunger, their tumult of hooves is a prelude to a swift and gory end. The Great Herds do not have an elaborate society, deferring to the authority of a few gigantic shamanic Elders. One of the eldest is Araatam Bloodmane, a wielder of glaive and magic in equal measure. His hide and mane are toned a deep crimson, his eyes burn with cunning and hate, most of all for the Dawi that scarred him as a youth.
